name: build-in-public
description: A local web app that turns your Git commits into X and LinkedIn posts, images and demo videos, drafted with the Claude Code and Codex CLIs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bip/shared build && pnpm --filter @bip/server build && pnpm --filter @bip/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bip/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.doctor: pnpm --filter @bip/shared build && pnpm --filter @bip/server build && node apps/server/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --filter @bip/shared build && pnpm --filter @bip/server build && node apps/server/dist/cli.js setup
